name: 28270 · Charlotte, NC
findings: ZIP 28270 (Charlotte) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28270 (Charlotte) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
